name: Suspicious Chicken Kitezhgrad
desc: A breaded chicken dish with a woefully uneven crust. Some patches are burnt black and bitter, while others remain pale and underdone. Cutting into it only makes matters worse. The butter has already slipped away during frying, leaving behind nothing but a dry piece of chicken sitting forlornly on the plate...

value.text: Increases all party members' Physical DMG by 20% for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).
